$comment: The link preview (Open Graph) card for each fixed page. npm run share-cards renders every card to src/app/<route>/opengraph-image.jpg with its .alt.txt. Headings are the page's own; no dashes in copy. Variants: photo (one photo), portraits (a grid of real portraits), panel (a berry panel with the pledge, for pages without a photo).
